body:
Two new Go-native subcommands (login, kanban list) added to cmd/idunapro, continuing the real, ongoing 'grow the fuller multi-subcommand CLI' thread across many prior status updates. Real, found-live bug fixed: no local user ever got kanban.access (webmaster included) -- fixed for uid=0, extending to regular users left as a real founder-level question. 9 new tests, go test ./... clean. Commit b25e064. Live-verified end to end: real registration/login/card-creation, the actual compiled binary correctly listing and filtering the real board.

⚓ ☃
title: Card 9988 status update: idunapro CLI grows to 3 subcommands (login, kanban list) + real kanban.access grant fix
